corrections.text: The article gives OpenAI and Anthropic per-token prices (for example gpt-6.1-sol at $2.00/$10.00 and Claude Opus 5.5 at $4/$20, with fast mode at $8/$40) without stating when the vendor pricing pages were read. The figures match OpenAI's pricing page, OpenAI's Ultrafast documentation and Anthropic's pricing and fast mode pages as read on October 22, 2026. These are live pages and the prices may change.

The sentence 'a developer comparing models would need cost per completed task and score on their own workload' in the Implications section is the Herald's analytic inference from the cited reports, not a statement made by any cited source.
